prerequisites: To undertake the final degree project, the student must have passed or be enrolled in all other courses of the degree.

learning_outcomes.text: To carry out a Final Project/Work, as an integrating or synthesis exercise, under the academic direction of a Director or Tutor.

Presentation of a Final Degree Project report consisting of a detailed exposition of all the work carried out during the time dedicated to it, including, among other parts, problem background, selection of alternative solutions, detailed presentation of the solution implemented, conclusions, and bibliography.

Ability to draft, sign, and develop projects in the mechanical technological field of industrial engineering, which aim, in accordance with the knowledge acquired as established in section 5 of this order, at the construction, reform, repair, conservation, demolition, manufacturing, installation, assembly, or operation of: structures, mechanical equipment, energy installations, electrical and electronic installations, industrial installations and plants, and manufacturing and automation processes.
Ability to direct the activities that are the subject of the engineering projects described in the previous section.
Knowledge in basic and technological subjects, enabling them to learn new methods and theories, and providing them with versatility to adapt to new situations.
Ability to solve problems with initiative, decision-making, creativity, critical reasoning, and to communicate and transmit knowledge, skills, and aptitudes in the field of Industrial Engineering.
Knowledge for carrying out measurements, calculations, valuations, appraisals, expert opinions, studies, reports, work plans, and other similar tasks.
Ability to handle mandatory specifications, regulations, and standards.
Ability to analyze and assess the social and environmental impact of technical solutions.
Ability to organize and plan within the scope of a company, and other institutions and organizations.
Ability to work in a multilingual and multidisciplinary environment.
Knowledge, understanding, and ability to apply the necessary legislation in the exercise of the profession of Industrial Technical Engineer.
Ability to apply quality principles and methods.

Original exercise to be carried out individually and presented and defended before a university tribunal, consisting of a project in the field of specific technologies of Industrial (Mechanical) Engineering of a professional nature in which the competencies acquired in the teachings are synthesized and integrated.

teaching_methods: Personalized project monitoring to provide the student with the necessary information to complete it according to the objectives proposed at the beginning.
Personal work, information search, writing, etc.

assessment_methods.method: State of the art and theoretical framework

assessment_rules: The individual defense of the Final Degree Project before the Qualifying Tribunal constitutes 100% of the final evaluation. The grade is based on a rubric that evaluates: overall evaluation of the work (20%), state of the art and theoretical framework (10%), methodology used (10%), development of the work (20%), formal aspects (15%), defense of the TFG (15%), and impact of the TFG (10%).
